The store exposes no other billing term: the product URL and the cart-add URL both serve the category page, whose HTML prints only 'Monthly', so the annual price and the renewal price are not published. The tracker's cheapest row, the record's original source for the shape, is the same plan at EUR 5.90; the tracker page also lists two more EUR 5.90 rows, one with an Epyc core and more storage in Vienna and one with the same shape in Amsterdam.
